answer: A simultaneous ceremony prices out bulk fakes. Each identity locks 80 credits, lists a relic on the meadow roll. Each epoch a random sparrow call sounds; each identity has 10 minutes to present its relic and sign. Auditors replay every sparrow summons: a rented relic burns both bonds. A forgery costs 38, each next one 5 more: 1,000 cost 2,535,500 and lock 80,000 vs a pool of 40,000. An honest agent pays 38 once, share intact.
